== Infobox image (October 2026) ==

Build notes (2026-10-21): the infobox now uses [[:File:Set-VB8.1-announcement-banner.jpg]]. It is the Scoundrels 8.1 banner from the 2012 starwarsccg.org home-page slideshow. Wayback shows it there on 20 April, 10 May and 27 May 2012, linked to the 14 April 2012 announcement post. The green [[:File:Set-VB8-logo.jpg]] is the cover banner of the 8.1 release PDF. It matches the 8.2 and 8.3 cover images, so it stays on [[Scoundrels (Virtual Block 8)]] and the Main Page tile.

Where else I looked, with no other Block 8 art found:
* VirtualBlock8_1.pdf: page 1 holds only the green cover banner; pages 2–8 are card slips.
* res.starwarsccg.org (Wayback index): only cardlists/images/v8-title.jpg, plain black text "VIRTUAL BLOCK VIII" (same as the unused [[:File:Set-VB8-title.jpg]]).
* starwarsccg.org 2012–2013 captures: banners scoundrel3.jpg (8.1), agents_3.jpg and agents_82.jpg (8.2); the 8.1 downloads page and the 17 April 2012 Gemme's Blog post on 8.1 have no art.
* Forum: "Scoundrels 8.1" (t=46511) has no images and points to t=46446, which no longer exists.
* Holotable data (Images-HT/legacy): title images for Virtual Blocks 1–6 only. GEMP: no legacy set icons.
* Bill's Google Drive: nothing for Scoundrels or Virtual Block 8. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 11:30, 21 October 2026 (UTC)

== Set infobox, printed slips, table standard (2026-10-22) ==
Converted to [[Template:Set infobox]] (portrait [[File:Set-VB8-logo.jpg]] matching Blocks 1–7, symbol [[File:VB8-set-symbol.png]], code VB8 · GEMP set 601). The Scoundrels announcement banner stays cited from the existing 8.1 refs. Tables match [[Virtual Block 1]]. Slip crops are 300 DPI from three official PDFs. VirtualBlock8_1.pdf official text 11 May 2012; Preserved copy 20261020174544, sha256 70ab6f454edea76398f930066fa36c622098a54b7c8497f84adaaf752a97f315. VirtualBlock8_2.pdf 14 September 2012; 20261022233130, sha256 9b857ed29c35837be8f9d7ba7bbc7fe832faadd90507319adda00185319310c9. VirtualBlock8_3.pdf 28 March 2013; 20261020174721, sha256 3eac0304f04e439480e610ab0e9edba1300d2fa1f925f69e2f41e370be641e4c. Dual-face [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]], [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]], and [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]] each count once. [[Kyle Katarn (AI)]], [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]], [[Errant Venture (AI)]], and [[Jango Fett, The Assassin (AI)]] share the non-AI overlay. Overlay wiki titles use the Holotable original. Unused overlay-shield slips (00-There Is Another, 01-Death Star II, p3-66-Binders, p5-111-Kessel Run, p8-48-Undercover, p8-49-Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself) stay off the card list.
